summary:
Iter 45 — 7/7 backend pytests PASS + all 4 UI flows green. Features exercised: (1) Table sponsor names on PUT /api/admin/events/{eid}/seating — {'1':'Smith Family','2':'Jones Co','5':'Overflow'} persisted with keys '1','2' only; '5' dropped because tables=3. Reducing tables to 1 drops the '2' sponsor. (2) Guest names: created a 100% event-scoped promo QAFREE…, POST /events/{eid}/tickets/checkout {items:[{General,2}],guest_names:['Ann','Bea']} → free path, _fulfil_ticket_order ran, GET /tickets/order/{token} returned both tickets with guest_name='Ann'/'Bea' and can_edit=true; PUT /tickets/order/{token}/names updated both; admin PUT /api/admin/events/{eid}/tickets/name {code,name} succeeded; wrong code → 404; GET /admin/events/{eid}/tickets/report guests[] shows guest_name as holder and buyer='Buyer QA'; GET /admin/events/{eid}/seating groups each include seats[{code,guest_name}]; after switching the event date to the past, buyer PUT names → 400 as spec. (3) Quarterly: GET /api/admin/accounting default quarterly=true; GET /api/admin/accounting/2024/summary.csv?quarter=2 first data row starts 'Quarter 2024 Q2'; quarter=5 → 400. In-process assertions (subprocess into /app/backend) confirmed _period(2024,0..4) and _acct_scheduled(datetime(2026,6,15,15,0,UTC)) → None without ever being called for Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct. /api/admin/accounting/send was NOT called. (4) Live gala: PUT /api/admin/events/{eid}/gala {goal:5000} → gala_goal=5000; GET /gala/{eid} initial goal=5000, raised=0, count=0; seeded one named + one anonymous paid payment_transactions row (session_id qa_gala_named_<worker>, qa_gala_anon_<worker>) → raised=250, count=2, recent names include 'Zora' and 'Anonymous'. GET /gala/<missing> → 404. POST /api/payments/checkout {gala_event_id:eid,...} inserts pending payment_transactions with event_id=eid, source='gala', payment_status='pending'. (5) Regression: iter44 promo+gift checkout (QAEARLY 20% + $50 gift, 2 General) still produces Stripe URL and ticket_orders with subtotal=150, discount=30, total=120, gift=50.

Frontend (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844 for gala): /gala/{eid} renders without site header, gala-screen+gala-raised+gala-goal+gala-bar+gala-recent+gala-qr all visible; goal text shows '$5,000 goal · 0 gifts'; mobile loads fine. /donate?gala={eid} shows gala-donate-banner 'Giving at QA Iter45 UI Gala: your gift will light up the screen!'. Admin > Events TicketTypesPanel exposes gala-goal-input/gala-goal-save/gala-screen-link. Admin > Reports > accountant-package shows acct-quarterly (checked by default), acct-quarter select (Full year/Q1-Q4), acct-year, acct-dl-summary and acct-send (not clicked). /tickets/{token} shows preloaded guest names Ann/Bea in ticket-guestname-1/2, saves via ticket-names-save → ticket-names-msg 'Guest names saved!'. /admin/tickets/{eid}/seating: seat-sponsor-1 input saves 'Smith Family' on blur and persists after reload; after Auto-seat the per-seat 'names' button appears as seat-names-<group>, and clicking it reveals seat-guestname-<code> inputs.
action_items: None — all iter 45 task features green.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_seating_set correctly drops sponsor keys for tables > payload.tables (int(k) <= payload.tables) and also unassigns tickets.table > new tables. Clean.
ticket_order_names gates by (event.date < today_et); correct for 'until the event day'. Admin StaffGuestNameIn trims to 60 chars. Both bound by rate-limit and admin dep.

gala_screen aggregates payment_transactions with event_id + payment_status='paid' summed via Python sum(float()); fine for up to 5000 txns per event. For larger events, consider a Mongo $group aggregation.

create_donation_checkout resolves gala_event_id -> event_id only if the event exists; however if the id is invalid the response quietly stores event_id=None and source still becomes 'gala' (because the ternary is `('gala' if req.gala_event_id else None)`). So a user-supplied bogus gala_event_id tags the txn source='gala' with no event_id. Minor consistency note (not a bug, but worth guarding).

_acct_scheduled key is `acct-q:{year}-Q{q}` where q = (month-1)//3 — i.e. for April (month 4) q=1, July q=2, October q=3. This DOES NOT match the request-side quarter numbering used by _period/admin_acct_download (quarter=1 means Q1 Jan-Mar). Important: _acct_scheduled sends the PREVIOUS quarter (fired in April for Q1, in July for Q2, in October for Q3), and `_send_acct_package(et.year, q)` passes the computed q, which then flows into _period(year, q) — meaning April run would send year-Q1 (correct) because q=(4-1)//3 = 1, July run q=(7-1)//3 = 2 → Q2 (correct), October q=3 → Q3 (correct). So the dual meaning works out. Just confusing to read; a comment would help.
GalaScreen.jsx uses QRCodeSVG with data-testid on the <svg>; the unit's `d.recent` is accessed without null guard but gala_screen response always returns `recent:[]` so OK.

Seating.jsx inline onBlur save calls api.put with the whole sponsors map every time an input blurs — works, but can race when two inputs blur back-to-back. For higher traffic consider a debounce or dedicated per-table endpoint. Non-blocking.

AccountantPackage.jsx 'acct-quarter' default is 0 (Full year); when sending Jan dedupe uses `acct:{year-1}` while quarterly dedupe uses `acct-q:{year}-Q{q}` — distinct markers so a Jan 5 run and a prior Oct 5 run do not collide. Good.
server.py is now 11,739 lines — still oversized; split-up remains overdue (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the iter45 selectors verified: gala-screen (+ gala-raised/goal/bar/recent/qr, no site header), gala-donate-banner, gala-goal-input/gala-goal-save/gala-screen-link, acct-quarterly/acct-quarter, ticket-guestname-1/2 + ticket-names-save → ticket-names-msg, seat-sponsor-1 (persists after reload), seat-names-<group> + seat-guestname-<code>.

test_credentials: QA admin cookie session_token=qa_tok_123 (python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_session.py up/down). Brought up for the run; torn down after.
seed_data_creation: Transient data created and torn down (0 QA rows remain): events 'QA Sponsors …', 'QA Guests …', 'QA Gala …', 'QA Reg …', 'QA Iter45 UI/UI2/UI3 …'; promo_codes QAFREE100*/QAFREEUI*/QAFREEX*/QAEARLY*; ticket_orders + tickets for the free orders; payment_transactions qa_gala_named_<worker>/qa_gala_anon_<worker> (deleted); any pending gala /payments/checkout txn created during the gala test was deleted after insert. staff_notify_email restored to caringsistersclub@gmail.com by qa_session.py down.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Running the test file alone (-n 0) passes in ~5s. The test file uses WT=PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER to tag seeded data; running under default xdist (-n 2 --dist loadscope) should also be safe since the classes are independent. Never call /api/admin/accounting/send and never call _acct_scheduled with a January/April/July/October datetime — doing so would email the real accountant. The TestQuarterly.test_period_values_and_acct_scheduled_june test executes server._acct_scheduled only with a June date, which short-circuits before _acct_cfg is consulted. The admin events listing is {items:[...]} (not a bare list) — I had to adapt the UI script to that shape. For free orders use a 100% event-scoped promo; _fulfil_ticket_order fires inline and session_id is `free_<order_id>` which /api/tickets/session/<sid> maps to a token. _acct_scheduled's dual quarter numbering ((month-1)//3 vs _period's 1-4) happens to produce the right calendar quarter — see critical_code_review_comments[4]. Also noted a minor consistency gap: /payments/checkout with an invalid gala_event_id stores source='gala' + event_id=None.
